content: s3d v0.2.1 openapi.yml (fetched raw 2026-10-21): GET /stats/uploads returns UploadStats{pendingObjects, pendingSize, uploadedObjects, uploadedSize, unpinnedObjects, failedUploads, orphanedObjects, multipartUploads, bufferUsed, bufferLimit, transfer:TransferStats{ingressActive,ingressBytes,ingressRate,uploadBytes,uploadRate,activeUploads[]:ActiveUpload{label,objects,size,sent,finalizing}}}. Counters are pipeline-GLOBAL, not per-object; ActiveUpload.label is bucket/key only while a group streams. POST /objects/flush uploads all pending objects immediately, pins, blocks until done. Admin API: 127.0.0.1:8001, HTTP Basic (username ignored). No per-object staged-vs-durable signal exists at v0.2.1.
